# Toolbar Sheets

<!-- Generated by generate-swiftui-skill.py; edit the library sources. -->

Category: Motion

On iOS 26, connect a toolbar button to its sheet with a zoom transition. Alternatively, attach a popover to the button and adapt it to a sheet in compact layouts. Inspired by Axel Le Pennec (@alpennec).

- Before: Sheet uses default presentation
- After: Sheet grows from its source

APIs: `matchedTransitionSource`, `navigationTransition`, `popover`, `presentationCompactAdaptation`

## Complete improved example

Adapt the behavior to the app; demonstration controls and values are illustrative.

```swift
import SwiftUI

struct ToolbarSheetsDoExample: View {
    @Namespace private var namespace
    @State private var presented = false

    var body: some View {
        #if os(iOS)
        if #available(iOS 26, *) {
            // excerpt:start
            NavigationStack {
                Text("Tap Add in the toolbar")
                    .toolbar {
                        ToolbarItem(placement: .primaryAction) {
                            Button("Add", systemImage: "plus") { presented = true }
                                .matchedTransitionSource(id: "detail", in: namespace)
                        }
                    }
                    .sheet(isPresented: $presented) {
                        VStack(spacing: 20) {
                            Text("New collection")
                            Button("Done") { presented = false }
                        }
                        .padding()
                        .presentationDetents([.medium])
                        .navigationTransition(.zoom(sourceID: "detail", in: namespace))
                    }
            }
            // excerpt:end
        } else {
            Text("Requires iOS 26 or later")
        }
        #else
        Text("Try this presentation on iPhone or iPad")
            .font(.caption)
        #endif
    }
}

// Alternative: iOS 26 animates the adapted popover from its button.
struct ToolbarPopoverAlternative: View {
    @State private var presented = false
    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            Text("Tap Add")
                .toolbar {
                    ToolbarItem(placement: .primaryAction) {
                        Button("Add", systemImage: "plus") { presented = true }
                            .popover(isPresented: $presented) {
                                Button("Done") { presented = false }
                                    .padding()
                                    .presentationCompactAdaptation(.sheet)
                            }
                    }
                }
        }
    }
}
```
